messages:
anya: quick note — our eval CLI defaults just bit us. ran a quantized bring-up with `--quantize auto` and got a huge perf/quality hit on translation tests.

mike: ugh. can you paste the exact command + config you used?

anya: `rwd-eval run --model /models/llama-2-13b --quantize auto --batch 8 --config evals/translation.yaml`
config had some metrics baselines; `auto` picked an aggressive int4 path on the GPU that regressed BLEU and rouge.

jordan: we should add a quick validation step that flags risky quantization combos and returns a non-zero exit code if a config looks unsafe.

sam: +1. also think a `--smoke` or `--quick-check` mode that runs a tiny subset (5 prompts) and compares to stored baselines would catch this in CI before long runs.

mike: agree. concrete: (1) config schema validation (jsonschema), (2) smoke-check CLI mode, (3) fail CI if smoke delta > threshold.

sam: i can prototype a minimal JSON schema. example snippet: ```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"quantize":{"enum":["none","int8","int4","auto"]},"preferred_precision":{"type":"string"},"batch":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["quantize"]}```

ci-bot: pipeline: eval-smoke #456 failed — smoke-check returned delta BLEU -12% (threshold -5%)

anya: oof. would have saved five hours of debugging :facepalm:

jordan: for devex UX, error messages need to be actionable. show offending key + suggestion, e.g. `quantize='auto' -> try --quantize int8 or set preferred_precision=bf16`.

mike: i'll open a PR. PR title suggestion: `devex: eval-cli add smoke-check + config validation + sane defaults`. i'll add explicit exit codes (1 = config error, 2 = metric regression).

sam: i'll add `rwd-eval validate <config>` that returns 0/1 and prints human-friendly fixes. also will add the JSON schema into `evals/schemas/`.

anya: also update docs quickstart with example: `rwd-eval validate evals/translation.yaml && rwd-eval run --smoke evals/translation.yaml` — and a CI snippet to gate on smoke exit code.

mike: assign: @sam = schema + validate command, @mike = CLI flags + exit codes, @jordan = CI job + gating. ETA: end of day Friday?

sam: can do, i'll post WIP PR link when ready.

ci-bot: reminder: rerun smoke pipeline after PR merge.
